pick.headline: Bosnian deputy premier shot dead under UN escort
pick.summary: On January 8, 1993, Bosnian Deputy Prime Minister Hakija Turajlic was shot dead by a Serb soldier at a checkpoint near Sarajevo while riding in a UN armored vehicle.
pick.significance: The killing, in the custody of UN peacekeepers, became a symbol of the UN's inability to protect anyone in Bosnia. It came as the Geneva peace talks were under way.
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of January 11, 1993, carried a Geneva report in which Cyrus Vance deplored the killing of Bosnian Deputy Prime Minister Hakija Turajlic, shot by a Bosnian Serb soldier while UN peacekeepers drove him from Sarajevo airport; the Bosnian Serb army protested that the UN had abused its airport mission.

alternates.headline: Francois Mitterrand dies
alternates.summary: On January 8, 1996, former French President Francois Mitterrand died in Paris, eight months after leaving office.
alternates.significance: Mitterrand had led France for fourteen years, through the end of the Cold War, German unification and the Maastricht treaty.
alternates.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of January 11, 1996, carried Warsaw TV Polonia's report that President Kwasniewski, leaving for Germany and France, said Mitterrand's death changed his schedule and he would attend the funeral ceremonies at Notre Dame.
